item.title: Strong supply keeps gas prices steady in R.I., Mass.
item.description: PROVIDENCE – The average weekly price of self-serve, regular unleaded gasoline in Rhode Island is unchanged from last week at $2.86 per gallon, AAA Northeast said Monday. item.title: Commentary: Man, machine and making wise choices in an AI economy
item.description: I’ve spent my life in manufacturing – real factories, real people, real machines. I’ve lived through multiple waves of technology – computer numerical control machines, robotics, enterprise resource planning systems and automation. Each time, the same fear surfaced: This will replace us. Each time, the truth proved more nuanced. Artificial intelligence is the next wave. […]

item.title: Lardaro: Data still signals recession in R.I.
item.description: PROVIDENCE – The state’s economy still has the look and feel of a recession, failing to build momentum in December after hopeful signs of recovery the previous month, University of Rhode Island economist and professor Leonard Lardaro said Monday in his monthly Current Conditions Index report.
